cues.zhText: 从暗红的单纯性、灰黄的化脓性，到焦黑的坏疽性，这是常见的典型演变路径。但请记住，有的病例可在早期控制，有的会迅速恶化，病程因人而异。
cues.enText: Dark-red simple, grayish-yellow phlegmonous, and black gangrenous appendicitis illustrate a typical course. The course varies: some cases can be controlled early, while others worsen rapidly.

cues.zhText: 镜下看，单纯性阑尾炎仍处于早期。中性粒细胞主要聚集在黏膜和黏膜下层。更深处可见肌层与浆膜层轻度水肿及少量中性粒细胞浸润。
cues.enText: Under the microscope, simple appendicitis shows early inflammation. Neutrophils gather mostly in the mucosa and submucosa. The muscularis propria and serosa show mild edema and sparse neutrophil infiltration.

cues.zhText: 化脓蔓延到阑尾壁全层后，肿胀使管壁张力升高，直接压迫阑尾壁动脉。阑尾系膜静脉同时可形成血栓，堵塞回流。动静脉双重受阻，严重时可彻底切断血供，造成阑尾组织缺血、坏死。
cues.enText: With transmural suppuration, swelling raises tension in the appendiceal wall, directly compressing the appendiceal wall artery. A thrombus can form in the mesoappendiceal vein and block outflow. Combined arterial and venous obstruction can cut off the blood supply in severe cases, leading to appendiceal ischemia and necrosis.

cues.zhText: 阑尾组织坏死后，继发腐败菌感染可形成坏疽，使阑尾发黑，这是坏疽性阑尾炎的典型外观。坏疽部位的管壁容易穿孔，脓液外漏可引发弥漫性腹膜炎。
cues.enText: After appendiceal tissue dies, secondary infection with putrefactive bacteria can cause gangrene. The appendix can turn black, a typical appearance in gangrenous appendicitis. The gangrenous wall is prone to perforation, and leaking pus can cause diffuse peritonitis.
